en: Did you know that every time musicians pick up their instruments, there are fireworks going off all over their brain?
zh: 知道每當音樂家彈奏他們的樂器時他們腦裡是到處在施放煙火嗎?

notes.zh: pick someone up：開車去接某人
notes.example: I can pick you up from the airport at seven.

en: On the outside, they may look calm and focused, reading the music and making the precise and practiced movements required.
zh: 由外表看來，他們很冷靜、專注看著樂譜，做出所需的準確和熟練動作

en: But inside their brains, there's a party going on.
zh: 但他們的腦裡正開著一個派對

en: How do we know this?
zh: 我們怎麼知道呢?

en: Well, in the last few decades, neuroscientists have made enormous breakthroughs
zh: 在過去的幾十年中，神經科學家對理解腦功能

notes.zh: you made it!：你成功辦到了／準時趕上了！
notes.example: I'm so glad you made it before the rain started.

en: in understanding how our brains work by monitoring them in real time with instruments like fMRI and PET scanners.
zh: 有了巨大的突破，功歸於能即時監測腦功能的儀器例如，功能性磁振造影 (fMRI) 、正電子發射計算機斷層掃描儀 (PET)

en: When people are hooked up to these machines, tasks, such as reading or doing math problems,
zh: 這些儀器掃描顯示閱讀、做數學題等行為

en: each have corresponding areas of the brain where activity can be observed.
zh: 引起腦內相應的活動區域

en: But when researchers got the participants to listen to music, they saw fireworks.
zh: 但給研究參與者聽音樂時神經學家看到了煙火

en: Multiple areas of their brains were lighting up at once, as they processed the sound,
zh: 處理聲音的同時腦裡多處同時亮起

en: took it apart to understand elements like melody and rhythm, and then put it all back together into unified musical experience.
zh: 將其分解成旋律、節奏等元素而後再重新組合成一個完整的音樂體驗

notes.zh: come together：順利成形、水到渠成
notes.example: Everything came together right before the deadline.

en: And our brains do all this work in the split second between when we first hear the music and when our foot starts to tap along.
zh: 這些大腦運作發生在聽到音樂和腳開始打節拍的一瞬間

notes.zh: just need a second：請稍等我們一下
notes.example: Sorry, we just need a second to check the menu.

en: But when scientists turned from observing the brains of music listeners to those of musicians,
zh: 而當科學家由觀察聆聽者的大腦轉至音樂家的大腦

notes.example: Observing small behavioral cues takes deliberate practice.

en: the little backyard fireworks became a jubilee.
zh: 後院的小煙火變成了禧年慶典煙火

en: It turns out that while listening to music engages the brain in some pretty interesting activities,
zh: 事實證明，聽音樂時大腦忙碌於一些很有趣的活動

en: playing music is the brain's equivalent of a full-body workout.
zh: 而彈奏音樂是相當於大腦的全身鍛鍊

en: The neuroscientists saw multiple areas of the brain light up, simultaneously processing different information
zh: 神經科學家看到了腦內多處亮起同時以複雜、

en: in intricate, interrelated, and astonishingly fast sequences.
zh: 互相關聯、驚人的快速序列處理不同的訊息

en: But what is it about making music that sets the brain alight?
zh: 但究竟彈奏音樂是如何將大腦點亮?

en: The research is still fairly new, but neuroscientists have a pretty good idea.
zh: 雖然該研究才剛起步但神經科學家有不錯的理念

en: Playing a musical instrument engages practically every area of the brain at once,
zh: 彈奏樂器同時動用到大腦幾乎每區域

en: especially the visual, auditory, and motor cortices.
zh: 特別是視覺、聽覺、運動皮質

en: As with any other workout, disciplined, structured practice in playing music
zh: 猶如其它鍛鍊有紀律、組織性的彈奏練習

en: strengthens those brain functions, allowing us to apply that strength to other activities.
zh: 能加強這些腦功能因而應用到別的活動

en: The most obvious difference between listening to music and playing it is that the latter requires fine motor skills,
zh: 聆聽和演奏音樂最明顯的差異是在後者需要精確運動技巧

en: which are controlled in both hemispheres of the brain.
zh: 這是受大腦兩邊半球控制

en: It also combines the linguistic and mathematical precision, in which the left hemisphere is more involved,
zh: 這也結合了大多處理語言及數學精準度的左半腦

en: with the novel and creative content that the right excels in.
zh: 以及擅長處理新穎、創造性內容的右半腦

en: For these reasons, playing music has been found to increase the volume and activity in the brain's corpus callosum,
zh: 由於如此，演奏音樂被發現能增加大腦胼胝體的容量與活動

en: the bridge between the two hemispheres, allowing messages to get across the brain faster and through more diverse routes.
zh: 胼胝體是大腦兩半球的橋梁讓訊息能以不同的路途更快速的通過大腦

notes.zh: run across someone：偶然遇見某人
notes.example: I ran across an old friend at the bookstore.

en: This may allow musicians to solve problems more effectively and creatively, in both academic and social settings.
zh: 這能使音樂家在學術和社會環境裡更有效、有創意的解決問題

en: Because making music also involves crafting and understanding its emotional content and message,
zh: 因為演奏音樂也觸及塑造和了解其感情內容與訊息

en: musicians often have higher levels of executive function, a category of interlinked tasks
zh: 音樂家通常具有較高水平的執行功能類屬有互相關聯的

en: that includes planning, strategizing, and attention to detail
zh: 計畫、策略、細節關注等

en: and requires simultaneous analysis of both cognitive and emotional aspects.
zh: 以及需要同時分析認知和感情方面的任務

en: This ability also has an impact on how our memory systems work.
zh: 這種能力也能影響記憶系統的運作

en: And, indeed, musicians exhibit enhanced memory functions, creating, storing, and retrieving memories more quickly and efficiently.
zh: 的確，音樂家有提高的記憶力功能能更快、有效創造、儲存、重拾記憶

en: Studies have found that musicians appear to use their highly connected brains to give each memory multiple tags,
zh: 研究發現音樂家似乎用他們高度連接的大腦給予每個記憶多個標籤

en: such as a conceptual tag, an emotional tag, an audio tag, and a contextual tag, like a good Internet search engine.
zh: 例如，概念性標籤、情感標籤、聲音標籤、語境標籤等猶如一個好的網路搜尋引擎

en: How do we know that all these benefits are unique to music, as opposed to, say, sports or painting?
zh: 那如何得知這些是音樂特有的益處而不是運動或繪畫等會有的益處?

en: Or could it be that people who go into music were already smarter to begin with?
zh: 或者接觸音樂的人會不會一開始就比較聰明?

en: Neuroscientists have explored these issues, but so far, they have found that the artistic and aesthetic aspects
zh: 神經科學家已探索這些問題但目前為止，發現了在學習演奏樂器的藝術、審美方面

en: of learning to play a musical instrument are different from any other activity studied, including other arts.
zh: 在學習演奏樂器的藝術、審美方面不同於其它研究過的活動包括其它藝術

en: And several randomized studies of participants, who showed the same levels
zh: 一些隨機研究，在開始時

en: of cognitive function and neural processing at the start, found that those who were exposed to a period of music learning
zh: 認知功能和神經處理有相同水平的參與者其中有受過一段音樂學習的人

en: showed enhancement in multiple brain areas, compared to the others.
zh: 相對於其他人，顯示多個增強的腦區域

en: This recent research about the mental benefits of playing music has advanced our understanding of mental function,
zh: 這有關演奏音樂對腦有益處的近期研究提升了我們對腦功能的理解

en: revealing the inner rhythms and complex interplay that make up the amazing orchestra of our brain.
zh: 顯示出構成腦內精彩管弦樂團內在的節奏以及複雜的互動
